steps.content: You're drained of air instantly as ice-cold water overwhelms your senses.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: ${PlayerName}!!! Hurry, quick, grab my hand!!
Familiar voices come faintly from the pool deck, anxious and scared. You want to swim to the surface and respond to them, but you can't make your way out.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Wh-why isn't he responding?! I'm going down there to get him out!!
steps.female_content: Wh-why isn't she responding?! I'm going down there to get her out!!

steps.content: No... don't jump into the pool! It's dangerous down here!
This is clearly a critical moment. You want to stop Kelvin from jumping in, but something wraps around your legs and tries to drag you to the bottom of the pool!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ah!!

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Want to keep enjoying the pool party with them?

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: If so, you can leave everything behind and keep having fun!
You hear a strange voice in your ear, but you're in no mood to care about what it's saying.
The force under your feet seems to be conscious, trying to drag you down at all costs.
You try to lift up your feet and break free from the thing entangling you, but whenever you make a move, your body sinks down a bit further.
With no strength left, the blue water before your eyes begin to blur.
The last string of bubbles pass before your eyes. You faintly hear that voice again...

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: All right, you guys are the first batch... Why is there someone uninvited among you...

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Forget it. Doesn't matter. Bid farewell together, indulgent souls.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Ch... ${PlayerName}! Are you all right?!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Don't worry, it's just a heat stroke. He'll be fine.
steps.female_content: Don't worry, it's just a heat stroke. She'll be fine.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: I... I brought him some cold drinks and fruit!
steps.female_content: I... I brought her some cold drinks and fruit!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Good job. Here, give them to me.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Mmm, he'll like this one.
Your lips get gently parted, and something cold enters your mouth.
The sweet juice flows from the tip of your tongue down your throat, calming your restless emotions.
You forcefully open your eyes, and find yourself resting on someone's lap.
Red, faintly grape-scented hair brush against the tip of your nose. The person asks softly:

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Are you all right? Do you feel a bit better?
You quickly sit up and look at her...
The woman who had been the center of attention just moments ago is now looking at you with a smile, as if wondering if you feel better.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cabernet...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You had a heat stroke and fainted. Poor dear.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: But don't worry, you're fine now.
Cabernet's words seem to have some sort of soothing power. Your throbbing temples and nerves calm down somewhat.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Ohh, look! That person woke up!

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: My goodness, Miss Cabernet is too kind... Look, her clothes are all wet...

steps.speaker: Guest C
steps.content: Who is that guy, anyways? He's dressed like a bumpkin... he's not from Syndicate, is he? Why does Miss Cabernet care so much about him...?
steps.female_content: Who is that girl, anyways? She's dressed like a bumpkin... she's not from Syndicate, is she? Why does Miss Cabernet care so much about her...?

steps.content: The onlookers chatter to each other, full of envy and curiosity.
That invisible feeling of dread hits you again. You suddenly remember the thing that wrapped around you underwater.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Am I the only one who got saved from the water?
Your clothes are still a bit damp. In this summery weather, they ought to dry very quickly. You quickly deduce that you haven't fainted for long.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The only one? Of course... You were the only one who got heat stroke in the pool.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I remember, I was...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Was what?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I was caught by something large and heavy that tried to drag me down. And this pool seemed... bottomless.
You look at the pool. It's still teeming with rowdy guests who are partying like nothing happened.
Of course, there's the possibility that something did happen, but it's no big deal to these guests.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Never mind. Thank you for saving me, Miss Cabernet.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You're welcome. These two helped a lot, so you should thank them, too... They are very concerned about the well-being of their Chief.

<size=31>You freeze. You catch the smile in Cabernet's eyes, realizing that she already knew your true identities. You're a bit taken aback, but then you realize that if she's influential enough to get the MBCC to do her bidding, it's only natural that she knows who you are.</size>
You turn to the worried Sinners and comfort them softly with a smile and nod:

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry for worrying you guys. I'm fine.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Miss Cabernet, since you already know our real identities, can you...
Before you finish speaking, Cabernet pulls you over to sit by her side.
You see that behind her, a guest is waiting to strike up a conversation with her. Seeing that you've already sat down and started chatting, the guest waits there for you and the Sinners to leave.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Would you accompany me for the rest of the party?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: With you by my side, I think I'd be able to avoid unnecessary interactions and focus on enjoying the party.
Cabernet flips open the manual and hands it to you. She points at the last scheduled event: the dinner banquet.
You understand what Cabernet wants. You salute her and respond loudly, imitating the tone of the other guests.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ah... of course! I'd be honored! You saved me, after all! I'll stay by your side for sure!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Hehe...
Cabernet chuckles softly, then lowers her head and moves close enough for you to smell the faint fragrance of tropical fruit on her body.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Happy working with you, MBCC Chief and his Sinners.
steps.female_content: Happy working with you, MBCC Chief and her Sinners.
